policy: a proposal is not a change: every entry carries applied=false until a new version proves otherwise

proposals.target: the eye patches move outward along the measured face surface until the pupil centres are 63 mm apart
proposals.method: translate each eye patch along the eye-line tangent and re-fit the lid seam; shape keys move with the patches because they are per-vertex displacement fields
proposals.risk: the lid opening is painted into the head texture, so moving the patches without repainting opens a seam
proposals.verification: re-measure the patch centroids, render eyes at 1024², compare to expression-02

proposals.target: widen the mouth mesh and the lip seam to 50.4 mm without moving the philtrum
proposals.method: scale the mouth cavity mesh on X about its centre and re-seat it behind the lip seam; the lip line itself is texture, so a repaint is part of the job
proposals.risk: a wider cavity without a wider painted lip reads as a hole
proposals.verification: render nose-lips, measure the cavity width, compare to expression-01

proposals.defect: lowest front hair sits 76.63 mm BELOW the eye line
proposals.reference: specification sheet: 87.68 mm of exposed forehead above the eye line
proposals.target: lift the front curl mass so the forehead is exposed to 87.68 mm above the eye line
proposals.method: select hair triangles inside the forehead band and displace along +Z with a falloff, preserving curl shape; the hair is a separate object in v0004 so this is now a local edit
proposals.risk: lifting the fringe uncovers the painted scalp under it, which is currently never seen
proposals.verification: re-measure the lowest front hair, render face-close-up and hairline, compare to expression-02

proposals.defect: calf segment (433.79 mm) is longer than the thigh (370.65 mm)
proposals.reference: human proportions: the calf is shorter than the thigh in every adult reference
proposals.target: confirm or correct the knee pivot so the two segments match the photographs
proposals.method: inspect the LeftLeg bone's rest positions against the mesh knee, then either move the pivot or accept it as a stylised choice
proposals.risk: moving a knee pivot invalidates the 31 clips authored against it
proposals.verification: pose the leg, render profile, re-measure the segment
